scope: All issue and PR bodies and all issue comments and reviews captured read-only. Team full-text synthesis is recorded separately; later editorial changes do not rewrite this snapshot.
capture_counts_interpretation: snapshot.counts.issues counts the GitHub REST issue endpoint including PRs; actual Issues=146 and PRs=318.

reading_coverage.boundary: Selective source-report inspection; not a claim to have reread every code file or cited paper.

interpretation: GitHub open/closed/merged/draft status is not scientific maturity.
Text mentions are navigation links, not asserted scientific dependencies.
Blob equality or absence does not decide semantic equivalence or whether a result exists elsewhere.
Historical title prefixes are preserved verbatim; they are not a newly assigned priority.
This finite snapshot is not a standing audit prerequisite for research.
